need.query: Record a meter check and inspect fixtures before buying monitoring equipment. Use the observations to choose a repair or further investigation.

claims.text: EPA recommends comparing water-meter readings across two hours with no water use; a change probably indicates a leak. It also describes a toilet dye test and fixture checklist.
